    Cocycles from a presentation #

    Let 0 → K → P → X → 0 be vertexwise exact, with a vertexwise section s. The maps δ_α = ι⁻¹(s X(α) - P(α) s) are extension data for X by K, with coboundary image in P. Pushing along φ : K → Y gives data for X by Y. These are cocycles when X and P are killed by the relations (mem_cocycles_push), and they vanish only if φ extends to P (extends_of_push). So the cocycles of X by Y are at least as many as the extension classes (two_le_cocycles).

          Independent extension classes give independent data. Let 0 → K → P → X → 0 be a vertexwise exact sequence of representations respecting the cover, and Φ : E → Hom(K, Y) a family, linear on vertices, such that the elements of E for which Φ e extends to P lie in N. Then relSub X Y has dimension at least dim E - dim N.
